about_the_game:
Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

SPECIAL FEATURES

- A unique progression system. Find the door to the next floor and use the key to proceed. But be careful! Just one wrong decision could lead you to death. Choose your next card that will make you one step closer to victory!

- Instinct-based roguelike. Make decisions at every turn. Find useful cards and combine objects found in the chests and bought at the shop to power up your character. But beware the traps and dangerous enemies!

-There's always one more try. You'll never feel fully prepared deep down the dungeon. The game is created for replay. Every new playthrough is unique and will feel fresh even to the most experienced players. Use your instincts and your character's unique abilities to fend off the dangerous creatures that lurk deep under the earth.

- Fully compatible with all gamepads, including Steam Deck.

- Stylish 2D pixel art.

HERE'S A TASTE OF WHAT YOU GET IN THE GAME

- 6 unlockable heroes. Each with unique passive abilities and spells that allow you to change your game style with every playthrough.

- Lots of colourful and detailed cards and items to unlock.

- More than 10 unique bosses, each requiring a special approach to defeat.

- If the game feels too challenging, you can use card upgrades to make your playthrough an easier experience.
